topRisks: Every in-repo wire client sends initialize protocolVersion 2025-06-18; a v2026_07_28-only server rejects that on stdio (-32022) and on HTTP (400 missing MCP-Protocol-Version) before any tool runs.

Public McpSchema.ClientRpcs has Initialize not server/discover, and RpcClient.layerProtocolHttp does not set Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name; there is no public Effect 2026 client group to point in-repo harnesses at.
Ontology CORS allowedHeaders omit mcp-method and mcp-name, so even a rewritten browser client would fail preflight against the desktop /mcp mount.
uspto_search_applications success is S.Array (non-object); 2026 structuredContent projection for arrays is an 11-u2 risk on that host.
nlp-mcp is the only .mcp.json in-repo server and has no stdio wire test, so a G4 flip can keep unit tests green while editor-launched sessions break.
decisionChallenges: G4 (v2026_07_28 only) plus G6 (in-repo launchers/harnesses/RpcClient in scope) are jointly unimplementable without rewriting every wire client in this lane, or relaxing G4 to Effect's mixed list (v2025_06_18 + v2026_07_28). Mixed list is an upstream feature (mcpRuntime.ts:193-209), not a beep invention.
Ontology GovernedTierGate freezes per-session grants; if 11-u2 finds no stable HTTP clientId on 2026, G4 on this host also changes the authority identity model (22-r3), not just the handshake.
grillQuestions: Relax G4 to a mixed protocol list on hosts that have in-repo initialize clients, or rewrite those clients first and keep G4?

Is ontology CORS expansion (mcp-method, mcp-name) in the protocol-flip PR or a separate host PR?
Should nlp-mcp gain a stdio wire canary before any protocol pin changes, given it is the .mcp.json launcher and currently has none?
Who owns a live handshake probe of Claude Code/Cursor/Codex against a 2026-only nlp-mcp (Gate A finding 25), since .mcp.json cannot record what those binaries send?
